newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Heavy supplies weigh on basis.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Heavy supplies weigh on basis.

text.p: Heavy supplies of soymeal caused a drop in some basis offers for soymeal by rail on Monday, U.S. dealers said.
"It's kind of a sloppy situation right now," said a broker in the southeast. "The temperature's going up and feed consumption is going down."
Summery temperatures in much of the U.S. have tempered demand for soymeal from poultry growers and dairy cow farmers, soymeal brokers said.
Dealers also reported growing supplies of unsold soymeal waiting for shipment by rail in the southeast and Midwest.
Despite the market's sharp drop in price recently, end-users are still reluctant buyers of July soymeal because of the stiff premimum that July holds to August.
One dealer said that end-users would not be heavy buyers in July until the last ten days of the month when the July CBOT contract has expired and basis offers are quoted over August.
